csharpDecision: EmitOwnedDropHelpers returns without emitting generic helpers for the primitive-only stack array/dictionary controls. Their physical lifetime is emitted independently.
slgSourceDecision: emitDropGlue already bypasses the generic helper when isPlannedContainerPayload is true; activeSemanticDropTypes seeded the same payload type without that exclusion, leaving an unused free helper.
fix: Use the same checked physical placement predicate in the active helper roots. Retain transitive nominal/enum/element drop closure and fail-fast placement effects.
